idea-plugin.name: Android + Build Files View
idea-plugin.description:
Adds a new "Android + Build" view that shows the same structure as Android view, but with build.gradle, proguard-rules.pro, and consumer-rules.pro visible under each module.

Usage:

  1. Open the Project tool window
  2. Click the dropdown at the top (where it shows "Android" or "Project")
  3. Select "Android + Build"

Features:

  • Same structure as Android view (manifests, kotlin+java, res, etc.)
  • Build configuration files visible under each module
  • No more scrolling to Gradle Scripts!
  • No restart required - Install and update without restarting your IDE
  • Customizable Settings Panel - Fine-tune which files and folders are shown

Settings Panel:

Customize which files and folders appear in the "Android + Build" view. Access settings in two ways:

  • Tool Window - Click the "Build View Settings" panel on the right sidebar for quick toggles with instant preview
  • Settings Dialog - Go to Settings → Tools → Android + Build View for the standard settings experience

Available options:

  • Source Folders - Show/hide kotlin+java, res, assets, test, and androidTest sources
  • Configuration Files - Show/hide AndroidManifest.xml, build.gradle, proguard-rules.pro, consumer-rules.pro, and .gitignore
  • Generated Content - Show/hide BuildConfig.java and the build folder
  • Other - Toggle other folders, other files, and external libraries
